verdict.rationale: Column documents webhook endpoints, configurable via API or Dashboard, for notifications about events (column-docs-7), and supports book transfers created in a "hold" state (column-docs-14), so an event-driven, hold-aware integration is plausible. However, the evidence never shows balance reads that separate available, pending and held funds. It also does not confirm that webhooks fire for every transaction state change. missing for 10: documented balance fields reflecting holds and pending activity, an explicit event catalog covering every transfer state transition, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time mirroring.
